concepts.title: Link editor
concepts.body: After a missing symbol, inspect the archive member list. Diagnostic code: birch.

concepts.title: Exclusive writers
concepts.body: Serialize updates with one lease per collection. Diagnostic code: alder.

concepts.title: Archive receipts
concepts.body: Compare the archived bytes before restoring a record. Diagnostic code: willow.

concepts.title: Backoff
concepts.body: Space successive retries after an upstream timeout. Diagnostic code: maple.

concepts.title: Theme contrast
concepts.body: Use distinct foreground and background tones for the selected row. Diagnostic code: oak.

concepts.title: Grid renderer
concepts.body: Derive column widths from the visible viewport. Diagnostic code: pine.

concepts.title: Pending input
concepts.body: Resume a waiting message once its owner reconnects. Diagnostic code: cedar.

concepts.title: Argument quoting
concepts.body: Keep spaces inside a single argument when passing a path. Diagnostic code: elm.
